title: 对话中的习语和口语表达
goal: 理解常见习语和口语表达，并在对话中区分字面义与语境义。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

points.label: 理解本课的习语和口语表达
在对话语境中判断其含义

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 习语和口语表达要整体理解。on the same page 是看法一致，不是在同一页。话题是书页时，page 也可能就是字面意思，要结合话题判断。
认同一个理由，不一定接受整个方案。You have a point, but the cost is too high 先承认理由合理，接着仍然反对。说话人的决定要看完整的回应。

cards.title: 词汇表：同意与反对
rows: I'm with you on keeping the original design.
承认对方的理由有道理
You have a point, but we still need permission.
接受理由或认为要求合理
Fair enough. We'll share the cleaning.
I couldn't agree more; the path needs lighting.
I'm not so sure the cheaper motor will last.
That's not quite what I mean
纠正对方对意思的理解
That's not quite what I mean; keep the title, not the picture.
It's helpful, but I wouldn't go that far and call it essential.
Let's check that we're on the same page about the deadline.
We don't see eye to eye on the color scheme.
cards.note: You have a point 只承认理由有道理。后面接 but I disagree with the conclusion，说话人仍不接受结论。

cards.title: 词汇表：困难与麻烦
rows: I'm tied up with deliveries until noon.
have a lot on one’s plate
Kim has a lot on her plate with two events to organize.
We're in a bind: the van is full and three boxes remain.
We've run into a problem with the booking.
I'm out of my depth with this electrical repair.
成功可能性较小的尝试
Calling another supplier is a long shot, but it's worth trying.
The extra furniture gets in the way of rehearsals.
The venue booking fell through, so we need another hall.
We're short of boxes for the donated toys.
状态或能力不足以做某事
I'm not up to a long walk after that busy shift.
cards.note: a long shot 是可能性低，但仍有可能。It’s a long shot, but I’ll call 说明说话人还是决定试一试。

cards.title: 词汇表：时间与安排
rows: The guide canceled at the last minute.
Please test the microphone ahead of time.
Use the side gate for the time being.
We put off the inspection until Friday.
在已有安排中挤出接待时间
The mechanic can fit us in after lunch.
在提前通知很少的情况下
Thanks for helping on short notice.
Sooner or later, the old roof will need replacing.
We check the spare battery every now and then.
婉拒本次邀请并希望改期
I'll take a rain check on dinner; I'm working tonight.
cards.note: take a rain check 没有定下新日期。I’ll take a rain check; can we choose a day later 是这次不去，改天再约。

cards.title: 词汇表：建议与决定
rows: The new route might be easier; let's give it a try.
It's a big purchase. I'll sleep on it.
We don't know when we'll finish, so let's play it by ear.
The choice of fabric is up to the customer.
Let's go with the smaller vehicle.
We can't rule out a delay.
I'll think it over before signing.
I've made up my mind to keep the original date.
We'll stick with the current supplier.
Could you give me a hand with these crates?
cards.note: be up to someone 是由某人决定；not be up to something 是精力或能力不够做某事。It’s up to Lee 和 Lee isn’t up to the hike 意思不同。

body.box:
Asha: Do we have to choose the fabric today?
Ben: No. It's up to us, but I'd sleep on it.
Asha: I agree. The blue one is attractive, though the gray one is cheaper.
Ben: Let's think it over and tell the seller tomorrow.

What does Ben suggest?
1. Buying the gray fabric immediately
2. Letting the seller choose the color
3. Waiting until tomorrow to decide
4. Ordering both fabrics for comparison

body.p: It’s up to us 说明由两人自己决定；sleep on it 和 think it over 说明先不定、再想想。第三项改写了 tell the seller tomorrow。
第一项把价格便宜当成了决定。第二项换了做决定的人。第四项把比较两种布料说成两种都买。

groups.text: The mural team agrees on the subject, but they don't see eye to eye on the colors.

items.stem: What does “don’t see eye to eye” mean?
options: They disagree about the colors.
They cannot see the mural clearly.
They have changed the mural’s subject.
They agree about every design choice.
items.why: 依据是 they don't see eye to eye on the colors。他们在颜色上意见不一致，即第一项；主题上是一致的。

groups.text: The repair crew is tied up at another building, so our inspection must wait.

items.stem: Why must the inspection wait?
options: The crew has finished both inspections.
The crew is occupied with another job.
The other building needs no repairs.
The crew has canceled all building visits.
items.why: 依据是 The repair crew is tied up at another building。维修队正在别处忙，即第二项。

groups.text: The tour was put off until Saturday; the route and meeting place stayed the same.

items.stem: What happened to the tour?
options: Its route was shortened.
Its meeting place was changed.
Its date was moved later.
Its Saturday date was canceled.
items.why: 依据是 put off until Saturday。参观推迟到周六，即第三项；路线和集合地点没变。

groups.text: The bakery order fell through, so we bought fruit for the reception instead.

items.stem: What does “fell through” describe?
options: The fruit was delivered to the bakery.
The reception was canceled entirely.
The bakery supplied the order late.
The planned bakery order did not happen.
items.why: 依据是 The bakery order fell through, so we bought fruit … instead。原定的面包店订单没能实现，即第四项；接待会改用水果。

groups.text: We have not chosen a campsite. We'll play it by ear when we see the conditions.

items.stem: How will the campsite be chosen?
options: According to conditions at the time
By keeping an already confirmed reservation
By selecting it before seeing the conditions
By asking every camper to choose separately
items.why: 依据是 We'll play it by ear when we see the conditions。到时看情况再选营地，即第一项；营地现在还没定。

groups.text: The coat fits well. I'll stick with this one instead of trying the newer model.

items.stem: What has the customer decided?
options: To compare both coats tomorrow
To keep the current choice
To switch to the newer model
To have the current coat altered
items.why: 依据是 I'll stick with this one instead of trying the newer model。顾客继续选这一件，即第二项。

lines.text: Can you help repair the puppet, Dana?
I'm out of my depth with the strings, but I can sew the costume.
That works for me. I'll ask the puppeteer about the strings.

items.stem: What does Dana mean by being “out of my depth”?
options: The string repair is beyond Dana’s skills.
Dana has too many costumes to sew.
The puppet is too far away to reach.
Dana has already repaired the strings.
items.why: 依据是 I'm out of my depth with the strings。修提线超出了 Dana 的能力，即第一项；缝衣服 Dana 可以做。

items.stem: What does the reply “That works for me” indicate?
options: The puppet’s strings now function correctly.
The puppeteer has agreed to sew the costume.
Dana’s offer to sew is acceptable.
No further help with the puppet is needed.
items.why: 依据是 I can sew the costume 和 That works for me。对方接受了 Dana 缝衣服的提议，即第三项；提线还没修。

lines.text: Can the brass band perform at our fair?
Their booking fell through because the date changed. We could try the choir.
It's a long shot on short notice, but I'll call.

items.stem: What happened to the brass band’s booking?
options: It was confirmed for the new date.
It did not go ahead as planned.
It was transferred to the choir.
It was confirmed at the last moment.
items.why: 依据是 Their booking fell through because the date changed。乐队的预约没能实现，即第二项。

items.stem: How does the organizer view contacting the choir?
options: As a confirmed replacement booking
As a way to change the fair’s date
As an arrangement made well in advance
As an attempt with a limited chance of success
items.why: 依据是 It's a long shot on short notice, but I'll call。成功的可能不大，但还是要试，即第四项。

lines.text: Shall we choose the picnic menu now?
Let's sleep on it. We still need to check the guests' dietary needs.
Fair enough. I'll collect that information tonight.

items.stem: What does “sleep on it” suggest?
options: Delay the choice until a later time
Choose now and check the needs later
Let the guests pick the menu tonight
Ask the guests to bring all the food
items.why: 依据是 Let's sleep on it. We still need to check the guests' dietary needs。先不选，过些时候再定，即第一项。

items.stem: What does “Fair enough” express here?
options: Doubt that any information is needed
Agreement that the picnic should be canceled
Acceptance of the reason for waiting
A decision to keep the existing menu
items.why: 依据是 We still need to check the guests' dietary needs 之后的 Fair enough。说话人接受了先暂缓的理由，即第三项。

groups.text: The repair may cost more than the old bicycle is worth. I'll think it over before agreeing.

items.stem: What does “think it over” mean?
options: Approve the repair immediately
Consider the decision carefully
Ask for a different bicycle at once
Refuse every possible repair
items.why: 依据是 I'll think it over before agreeing。说话人还没同意，要仔细考虑，即第二项。

groups.text: The lanterns are ready ahead of time; the festival does not begin until next week.

items.stem: When were the lanterns prepared?
options: After the festival had begun
At the latest possible moment
Earlier than they were needed
Only after next week’s opening
items.why: 依据是 ready ahead of time 和 does not begin until next week。灯笼提前做好了，即第三项。

groups.text: Our flower seller can fit us in between two appointments, though the shop is fully booked.

items.stem: What can the seller do?
options: Find a brief time to serve the customers
Cancel every appointment at the shop
Reserve the entire day for the customers
Ask the customers to return after all appointments
items.why: 依据是 can fit us in between two appointments。卖花人能在两个预约之间挤出一点时间，即第一项。

groups.text: The new bags may leak, so we cannot rule out using the old containers.

items.stem: What does “cannot rule out” mean here?
options: Must stop using the old containers
Have already discarded the old containers
Can guarantee that the new bags will work
Must keep the old containers as a possible option
items.why: 依据是 The new bags may leak, so we cannot rule out using the old containers。旧容器仍是一个可能的选择，即第四项。

groups.text: We have a lot on our plate with the harvest and the market stall both needing attention.

items.stem: What does the expression describe?
options: Having too much food at the stall
Having many responsibilities at once
Serving a large meal after the harvest
Moving all harvest work to the market
items.why: 依据是 a lot on our plate 和 the harvest and the market stall both needing attention。同时有许多事要处理，即第二项。

groups.text: The panel looks solid, but I'm not so sure it will survive outdoors all winter.

items.stem: What does the speaker express?
options: Certainty that the panel will fail indoors
Agreement that appearance proves strength
Doubt about the panel’s ability to last outside
A decision to keep the panel outdoors permanently
items.why: 依据是 I'm not so sure it will survive outdoors all winter。说话人怀疑面板能否在室外撑过冬天，即第三项。

lines.text: Are we ordering the new display cases today, Luis?
I'd like to think it over. The wooden ones look better, but the metal ones are easier to move.
Fair enough. We don't need them until next month.
For the time being, let's use the cases we already have.
That works for me. We'll compare the new ones again tomorrow.

items.stem: What does Luis mean by “think it over”?
options: Consider the alternatives before buying
Ask the supplier to choose the wooden cases
Purchase the lighter cases immediately
Decide against replacing any cases
items.why: 依据是 I'd like to think it over 和 The wooden ones look better, but the metal ones are easier to move。Luis 想比较两种柜子再买，即第一项。

items.stem: What does “for the time being” mean here?
options: For every future display
Only after the new cases arrive
Until the existing cases are sold
Temporarily while the choice is unresolved
items.why: 依据是 For the time being, let's use the cases we already have。新柜子还没选定，暂时用旧的，即第四项。

lines.text: Mina, can you help finish the costumes for the parade?
I'm tied up with the masks until noon. Could I join after lunch?
That works for me. The costumes just need their buttons attached.
Good. I'm short of buttons here, but I can bring thread.
We've got enough buttons at the workshop. Bring the thread and we'll work together.

items.stem: Why does Mina say “I’m tied up”?
options: The costumes are too tight to wear.
The masks are occupying Mina’s time.
Mina has already finished the masks.
The masks cannot be fastened securely.
items.why: 依据是 I'm tied up with the masks until noon。中午前 Mina 忙着做面具，即第二项。

items.stem: What does Mina mean by being “short of buttons”?
options: The buttons are too small for the costumes.
The buttons must be attached before lunch.
The available supply of buttons is insufficient.
The workshop has no buttons left.
items.why: 依据是 I'm short of buttons here。Mina 手边的纽扣不够，即第三项；工坊的纽扣是够的。
